summary: Opt-in AssistantShell slots instead of CSS overrides: showModeMenu, renderModeMenu, historyPane as a function (open, drawer, close), historyTitle, classNames.history, session icons on the shell and SessionSwitcher, useSessionLock. Without them nothing changes.
howTo: Nothing to do for the default. Replace CSS that hid [data-element="mode-picker"] with showModeMenu={false} or renderModeMenu={({ modes, current, setMode, label, title, entries }) => …} (both turn off the built-in key handling). An own historyPane that must close the drawer below 900 px becomes historyPane={({ close, open, drawer }) => …}; close() moves focus to the composer (an own input composer carries data-glirastes-composer), close('toggle') to the chats toggle. Render functions are rendered as components; pass a stable function and switch panes inside it. With an own pane, set labels.history, showHistory and hideHistory. historyTitle={false | node | fn} replaces [data-element="history-title"]. icons={{ newChat, rename, delete }} on the shell or on SessionSwitcher replace the + and the rename and delete icons (DEFAULT_SESSION_SWITCHER_ICONS). Replace isSessionChangeBlocked ?? isLoading in own session controls with useSessionLock().locked (also false while a ChatWindow is hidden). See placing-the-assistant.md, Replacing shell parts.
